name: ErrorSummary
summary: The list of a form's errors at its top after a failed submit: "There is a problem", then one link per error that takes the person to its field. Built on Alert's error tone in the section placement. Not for one error near its field (Field's message does that) or for a failure of saving (an Alert with Retry).
a11y: Takes focus when it appears, so a screen reader reads the title and the list at once (no live region, so it is never said twice). Each link moves focus to its field's control and scrolls its label into view; the page's address doesn't change. Each message repeats the field's own error, which the field still shows.

props.name: errors
props.description: Every error in the form, in the order the fields come. Nothing renders while it is empty.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The title's level in the page's outline. Defaults to 2.

props.name: focusOnShow
props.description: Takes focus when it appears or its errors change, so the person learns at once that the form didn't go through and where to go. Defaults to true; set false only when the summary is there as the page opens.

props.name: target
props.description: The field the error belongs to: its control's `id`, or the `data-error-target` value set on the field (for components that make their own ids, e.g. `<TextField data-error-target="email" … />`).

props.name: message
props.description: The same words as the field's own error message, e.g. "Enter an email address like name@example.com".
